items.label: One signature motion per section
items.notes: Support motion (enter, stagger, fade) may exist. Only one named primitive is the design after land.

items.label: Enter once on view, then interact
items.notes: Every section plays one temperament-matched enter from enter-recipes.json (56 recipes) once when it meets the viewport. Click/hover/pin/accordion start after land. No how-to copy. Reduced motion skips enter. Pick from ENTER.md, do not invent a unnamed fade.

items.label: Enter matches language temperament
items.notes: elegant: stamp-settle, drop-drape, typeset-rise, silk-slip, iris-open. aggressive: click-in, stomp-in, tick-print, bolt-down. rebellion: slap-in, shear-slice, skew-slam, offset-print. fun: pop-in, snap-elastic, hop-in, wobble-land. Full map in ENTER.md. Never pop or slap on fintech or editorial.

items.label: One language + one theme
items.notes: Do not mix liquid-glass type with brutalist radius with Material color.

items.label: No kit stack
items.notes: Marquee + bento + shiny text + aurora + border beam in one section.

items.label: Do not default glass onto fintech
items.notes: Orbit/Axiom trust is chrome-quiet. Glass only if the SKU is explicitly Prism-paired.

items.label: Do not reuse Helix orbit as Features
Cursor-flee is not default contact
items.notes: Allowed only when the brand can be playful (Phobia-class).

items.label: No registry install as the product
items.notes: Reimplement the mechanic. Coverage checklist only for shadcn/Magic UI/Oxygen/Amicro/shadcnblocks.

items.label: Stub primitives cannot ship
items.notes: Fill numbers in motion-primitives.json before a SKU cites a stub id.

items.label: Wow register is opt-in
items.notes: jewel-chrome, velvet-nocturne, candy-couture, kinetic-poster, ceramic-gloss, resin-object, ink-riot, solar-gilt, op-signal, arcade-atelier. Pair with a wow theme and one wow primitive. See WOW.md.

items.label: Wow is not default fintech or Swiss
items.notes: Do not put candy-couture, arcade-atelier, or strobe on calm-fintech / swiss-minimal unless the operator explicitly asks.

items.label: One wow primitive per section
items.notes: No jelly + strobe + sequin + chrome drip stacked. Enter is separate.

items.label: Wow is not Magic UI
items.notes: Aurora mesh, shiny H1, border beam, emoji confetti, neon city, rainbow chrome still fail even on the wow register.
